# @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.6.15

Visual-compliance release for DeepSeek Harness `0.1.7-rc.2`.

## Changed

- First-level Automation tasks title typography and page insets now follow the native DSH Schedule page more closely.
- Filter controls use the native quiet 28px pill-tab visual treatment.
- Ordinary cards and controls use the DSH semantic radius scale instead of local 7/8/9/12px radii.
- Intentional pills and circular status dots explicitly retain round geometry.
- Literal dark color fallbacks were removed in favor of DSH theme tokens.
- Keyboard focus rings use the shared DSH focus-ring variables.
- The native-detail loading placeholder is localized instead of hardcoded in English.
- Russian notification-setting copy was polished.

## Compatibility and scope

- Requires `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2` exactly.
- This is intentionally a visual-only compliance pass. The known `0.6.x` native-detail bridge, slot-entry reuse, DOM observation, and rc2 client-internal integration remain unchanged in this release line.
- Those architectural deviations will not be carried forward blindly: the next implementation line targeting DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` will be rebuilt against that version's official plugin guidance.

## Install

```bash
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.7-rc.2 plugin --profile web add @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab@0.6.15
```
